query: 人才储备与发展战略 人才储备与发展战略 衡量企业关键人才梯队的建设能力、核心岗位继任规划的成熟度。重点考察人才盘点机制、高潜人才储备计划、关键岗位的后备机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备完善的人才盘点机制（如九宫格评估）；针对所有关键岗位制定了明确的继任计划（含“即时/中期/长期”继任者）；建立了关键岗位风险监控与动态调整机制。 • 1分（合格）：建立了基础的人才库或管培生计划，有定性的继任规划描述，但缺乏系统的岗位风险评估或针对关键岗位的结构化继任名单。 • 0分（不合格）：无人才储备相关披露，或仅笼统提及“重视人才培养”。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：继任计划覆盖 >80% 的中高层管理岗位及关键业务/技术岗位。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对集团最高管理层，或未说明具体关键岗位的覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 人才盘点 继任计划 关键岗位 高潜人才 领导力梯队 九宫格 管培生 后备人才 9-box talent review succession planning key positions high-potential talent leadership pipeline 9-box grid management trainee bench strength 9-box 是否建立人才盘点机制（如九宫格）？ 是否有高潜人才储备或管培生计划？ 关键岗位是否有即时/中期/长期继任者安排？ 是否监控关键岗位空缺或继任风险？ 继任计划覆盖多少中高层及关键业务/技术岗位？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '人才储备与发展战略'. results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

Materiality Assessment

[Content]
A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

results.text: The Group understands that employees are important assets and its business development depends on their hard work. results.text: An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.
